es and fr texts checked on title (with and without Continue), settings, play, paused, shop, won, lost: all translated (e.g. 'Oleada 1 de 8', 'Vague 1 sur 8', 'La porte est tombee'). Only doubt: Spanish 'Enter: titulo' keeps the key name Enter (see defects).
Run 1 set volume 3, French, Hard; run 2 on the same --data started with fr/3/hard; a fresh folder started en/5/normal.
Up held 10 ticks: guard_y 6.0 -> 7.0 (6 u/s); held up 200 ticks -> 12.0, held down -> 0.0, never beyond.
Shoot held from tick 0: new bolts at ticks 1, 25, 49, 73 (24 apart), x +0.2333/tick (14 u/s); bolt at 18.8 at T73 gone by T79 (would be 20.2).
Wave 1 spawns at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (90 = 1.5 s), 5 walkers, lanes 4,10,2,6,2, health 2, x 20 -> 18.5 after 60 ticks (1.5 u/s); no 6th.

Guard at y 4 shooting: walker health 2 -> 1 at ~T92 (bolt removed), destroyed at ~T112 with score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y 6 passed walker in lane 4 (T200 bolt 14.6 vs walker 15.03, T205 bolt 15.77, walker still health 2).

No shooting: walker x 0.0 at T801, gone at T802 with gate 10 -> 9, score/coins 0. Hard run letting all through: screen lost, gate 0, texts show 'Final score: 0'; continued run lost shows 'Final score: 50'.
Difficulty Easy then Start: gate_health 14; Hard then Start: 7.

Bot cleared wave 1: at T530 screen shop, saved true, texts Coins: 5, 'Next: wave 2 of 8', Quick hands - 5 coins, Heavy bolts - 12 coins, Mason - 4 coins, Next wave; state identical 300 ticks later even with escape/up held.
Quick 1 bought (coins 5->0): held-shoot bolt gaps 4.2 units = 18 ticks. Quick 2 (10 coins): gaps 2.8 = 12 ticks. With 33 coins q,q,q,h,h -> coins 6, quick 2, heavy 1 (third quick changed nothing).
Heavy bought with 12 coins after wave 2; in wave 3 a walker at health 2 destroyed by one bolt (score 120->130). Second heavy purchase with 21 coins left coins unchanged.
Gate 5, 7 coins: Mason -> gate 8, coins 3; again with 3 coins: no change. Gate 8, 13 coins: Mason -> 10 (not 11), coins 9; again at 10/10: no change. Gate 5 with 0 coins: no change.
Next wave pressed before step 531: no enemy at T589, walker at x 20 at T590 (60 ticks); wave 2 sent 7 walkers 90 ticks apart; play texts 'Wave 2 of 8' ('Oleada 2 de 8', 'Vague 2 sur 8').
Wave 3 sent wwwwwwrrrr 72 ticks apart; runner health 1, x 20.0 -> 19.95 per tick (3 u/s); runner kill at T1918: score 170->185, coins 17->18.
Wave 4 sent 8 walkers then 1 brute (health 6, x 20 -> 19 in 60 ticks). Brute kill T3223: score 320->360, coins 30->33. Easy run ignoring brute: brute at gate took gate 14->11, score unchanged.
work/waves.json holds kinds and 8 waves (walkers/runners/brutes/interval); code reads it; README section 'Changing a wave' explains editing it.
Bot played all 8 waves via CLI (8430 ticks): screen won, score 1540 = 1340 points of all enemies + 20x10 gate; Enter -> title showing 'Best: 1540'.
Escape at T300 -> paused; at T500 enemies/bolts/guard identical to T300 despite held up/shoot; Enter on Resume -> next step equals the unpaused T301 enemies/bolts; Title -> title screen.
saved false in wave 1, true when shop opened; later run on same folder: title texts Start, Continue, Settings, Quit.

Bought Quick (coins 0, quick 1), gave up in wave 2; Continue -> shop wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1 ('10 coins - 1/2'); Next wave -> wave 2 play with an enemy entering. Same continue+inputs twice: identical states.

Start with a save -> saved false, later title has no Continue. Continued run lost -> saved false, no Continue. Won run -> saved false, title no Continue. Title from pause kept run.json from the last shop (Continue shown).
Win 1540 -> best 1540 on won screen and in a later run title; then a loss with 0 kept 'Best: 1540' (lost screen and title). Fresh folder loss with 50 -> 'Best: 50' on lost and title.
Two 3000-tick runs, seed 7, identical copies of a saved folder, same script: identical JSON. Wave 1 lanes seed1 [4,10,2,6,2], seed2 [2,2,2,6,4], seed99 [8,8,4,10,4].

Frame at T7535 (wave 8): green gate at left, blue guard at y 2, green circle walkers, yellow triangle runners, red square brute, yellow bolt, all at the state's positions (40 px/unit, y up); HUD Score 1115, Coins 91, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 10.

Title (Settings marked, en; Empezar marked, es), settings es (Idioma marked), shop en (Heavy bolts marked) and shop fr (Mains rapides marked): highlighted bar on the chosen entry, text in the chosen language.
work/strings.json has en/es/fr tables; view.py looks every string up there; README 'Adding a language' explains copying a block.
README covers controls, the data folder (--data, default userdata/, settings.json/best.json/run.json) and the headless and --frame commands, which worked as written.

defects: Spanish lost/won screens say 'Enter: titulo': the key name stays English (Spanish keyboards label it Intro); French uses 'Entree'.
An enemy reaching x = 0 stays one tick at x 0.0 before the gate takes its damage (harmless).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
